name: Modern Web Guidance
summary: A set of skills that gives coding agents current web platform knowledge and browser compatibility data. It nudges agents away from older JavaScript-heavy patterns and toward native browser features. It is stewarded by the Chrome, Edge, Firefox and MDN teams together with the web community.
install_steps: Follow the interactive wizard to choose how to install it
Optionally try it first with npx modern-web-guidance@latest search followed by a topic
See the repository README for alternative installation methods
example_use_case: Your coding agent keeps building a modal from a div plus custom JavaScript. With this skill installed, it can look up guidance on the native dialog approach and use that instead.
